## Synopsis

Reads the ai.straza/object marks on the server's live tools and opens a draft that
writes them into the manifest's straza.objects block. A mark the manifest already pins
stricter stays as pinned. Nothing changes until a person publishes the draft, and the
draft's check says what still needs a decision. A server that is not running, or
whose tools carry no marks, refuses and says what to do instead.

```
strazactl apps objects draft <server> [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  strazactl apps objects draft objects-demo
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER)
```
